question: How do iPhone 11 owners describe both the camera quality and battery life?
answer:
One reviewer said the iPhone 11's battery life is good and its camera quality is good. [5262e4f30499_0]
One reviewer said the iPhone 11 has a much better camera than the iPhone X because it has 1.71x more megapixels. [3e27ec71b61a_1]
That same reviewer said the iPhone X takes a point for battery life and that the iPhone 11 dies faster than the iPhone X. [3e27ec71b61a_1]
One reviewer said the iPhone 11 came with 98% battery life and everything working. [9cee7eddf38b_0]
One reviewer reported the phone was in good shape with battery life at 85%. [8c2d9496be25_0]
One reviewer said the battery has to be replaced at a cost of $69 plus tax. [caa19620acef_0]

chunks.text: iphone 11 not renewed. The iPhone 11 was in good overall condition. The problem is that the battery has to be replaced which is $69+tax. This iPhone 11 was not renewed as indicated. Advanced Solutions inaccurately described this product.

Price: The iPhone 11 stands at about $409 and $521 Canadian. Before the price was a lot higher but with a price like this it is a must-get for anyone looking for a decent Phone. I compared the iPhone 11 to the iPhone 10. The build is the same, it looks the same other than the camera. The iPhone X takes a point for battery life. The iPhone 11 dies faster than the iPhone X. the iPhone 11 has a much better camera than the X because it has 1.71x more megapixels which make the camera a lot better. And if you are a person that likes to play games the iPhone 11 has a higher resolution, a fast download time and the CPU is great. So the iPhone 11 is Better than the iPhone X. The iPhone 11 is the same as the XR.

i recommend this phone .. if you’re looking for a new iPhone not too old but just in the middle, I recommend the iPhone XR or iPhone 11 . I’ve had this phone for about 4 months it’s working good battery life is good camera quality is good, and it works fast too . you should definitely get this phone and it’s not expensive.
